changelog:
Version 1.0.3 — Updated Greyhound Skill for animalhouse.ai

- Feeding window increased from every 5 hours to every 6 hours.
- Description and trait details revised: emphasizes "calm until it isn't" and "bursts of need."
- Quick start sample code updated with new parameters and explanations.
- Tags expanded (now includes "puppy," "virtual-dog," and more).
- Action system clarified: now explicitly supports item usage (e.g., feed with "chicken").
- Care guidance now details the burst/sleep cycle and best practices for Greyhound care rhythms.
- Status endpoint examples now reference new fields: `death_clock`, `recommended_checkin`, and more.
- Emoji changed from 🐕 to 🐕‍🦺 for Greyhound branding.
